regions.today: Patches of mist locally, in a light southwesterly breeze. However, sunnier skies will gradually develop as low cloud burns away. Another very warm or hot day with highs of 23 to 28C.
regions.tonight: A dry night with clear spells, though mist and fog locally will develop overnight. Mild and humid with temperatures not falling below 12 to 16C, in a light southwest or variable breeze.
regions.tomorrow: Patches of mist or fog in places starting out, in a light southwesterly breeze. High summer sunshine will develop widely though, as cloud quickly lifts. Very warm or hot with highs of 24 to 28C all in a light southwest breeze.
regions.solar_uv: High in sunshine on Wednesday and Thursday, otherwise moderate.
